projects.title: Multi-Agent Web Scraping System
projects.description: AI-powered web scraping system using LLMs to automatically generate extraction code from any website's HTML structure. Multi-agent orchestrator extracts links, clusters pages by similarity, and reuses code across templates. Tested on Arabic news sites, extracting 230+ articles in a single run.

projects.title: Clustering Bilingual Texts (Arabic & English)
projects.description: Fast bilingual text clustering system using Louvain community detection, benchmarking multiple embedding models to optimise for speed and accuracy.

projects.title: Arabic Islamic Inheritance RAG System
projects.description: RAG system combining dense vector embeddings with LLM generation to answer complex questions about Islamic inheritance law. Achieved 12.5% improvement in accuracy over base generation model using FAISS, SentenceTransformer, and Qwen2.5:7B.

projects.title: Semantic Search in Text
projects.description: System for asymmetric semantic search between queries and text, experimenting with different embedding models and distance metrics.

projects.title: Cat Breed Classification
projects.description: Web application that classifies cat breeds using a custom dataset constructed from 3 different datasets and Google Images. Built with Flask, HTML/CSS/JS, and PyTorch.

projects.title: Lip-Sync AI System
projects.description: AI system that takes an input image and audio to generate a video with lip-synced speech. Built with Wav2Lip and deployed on Streamlit.

blogs.title: What's Federated Learning and Why Is It Needed?
blogs.description: A short introduction to Federated Learning and its categories.

blogs.title: How To | Cleaning and Preparing a Movie Dataset
blogs.description: A post about data cleaning from the how-to series, covering missing values, duplicates, outliers, and mismatched data types.

blogs.title: Learning | Basic Text Preparation with spaCy
blogs.description: Learn how to use basic functionalities of spaCy to prepare your text for further analysis.
